installCommand: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s -- bun-v1.4.0 && export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" && export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH" && bun --version && bun install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" && export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH" && bun run build
